verdict.rationale: Datalab sends webhooks when processing jobs complete, with a per-request `webhook_url` override. Pipelines chain processors into versioned configurations. Together these give an event hook that external code can act on, but there is no evidence of a native rules engine where users define conditions that trigger actions automatically. Missing for 10: user-defined event rules/conditions, triggers beyond job completion (e.g., on upload), built-in action execution without external code, independent corroboration.
